plan.title: AD lesional vs control: Hallmark pathway enrichment (GSEA)

The plan starts from the delivered DESeq2 results, prepares a fully ranked gene list (no pre-filtering), runs preranked GSEA (fgsea algorithm via gseapy, since the user constrained every script to Python) against the MSigDB Hallmark human 2026.1 collection staged in the reference store, follows up with the Reactome and WikiPathways human collections per the sourced procedure, and reports the enriched sets with leading-edge genes, gene-set size window, ranking metric and collection versions stated explicitly. A sample QC step is included first because the profile flags sample_01 at ~4x below median library size in the raw counts file, which could distort the underlying DE stats the ranking is built on; this is a diagnostic-only check since the DE results are pre-computed and not re-fit here.
